key_impacts: About 14 inches of rain fell in four hours during the storm
The Acelhuate River became a torrent that ripped away bridges and obliterated homes
Approximately 30 houses were destroyed and more than 100 were damaged
Around 300 residents evacuated to safety after a yellow alert was issued
